summary: This proposed absent-root entry indexes a Syriac prayer quotation embedded in Turoyo speech. It is explicitly restricted to that register and supplies no evidence of productive Turoyo kšp morphology.

The historical Ethpaal attribution is represented provisionally by the glossary’s II Detransitive section; the semantic use is supplication by the addressees, not an event undergone by them. Detransitive here is the glossary’s morphological label.

Lookup confirms no kšp entry. The existing kšf entry has uncovering/discovery/medical-examination senses, which do not fit this invocation. Do not merge the prayer into those senses or normalize source etkašaf.
Plural saints and following abʕaw support plural address, but the expected plural ending is not visible in etkašaf. No Preterit/Infectum base or missing ending is reconstructed.
Jan English is the project machine translation, not an edition translation. It is reproduced only as supplied and is not evidence for senses; all semantic decisions rest on the Turoyo.
